name: grammaropolis-teachers
description: Six grammar and writing tools for Grades 1-8 teachers, taught by the Grammaropolis characters: a pacing guide, a lesson planner, daily sentence warm-ups, exit tickets, a prewriting toolkit, and writing rubrics, with the Grammaropolis catalog connector.

interface.longDescription:
Grammaropolis teaches grammar and writing through characters who are the parts of speech and the punctuation marks. Nelson the Noun files every name in town, Vinny the Action Verb is always mid-rescue, and the Mayor certifies good work.

This plugin gives teachers of Grades 1 through 8 six classroom tools built on that cast:

- Pacing guide: plans your grammar year week by week from your calendar and standards.
- Lesson planner: builds one complete lesson on a topic or a standard, with a character-led hook and the full Learn, Assess, Practice, Create, and Certified cycle.
- Daily sentence: writes five-minute warm-ups with a key that explains every answer.
- Exit tickets: writes short checks whose keys tell you what each wrong answer means, so you know what to reteach.
- Prewriting toolkit: runs one story through eight prewriting techniques so students see how each one works.
- Writing rubrics: builds Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Not Yet rubrics for seven writing modes, with a student self-check.

It also connects to the Grammaropolis lesson catalog, so you can find the lessons that teach a Common Core or Texas TEKS code, browse by grade and topic, and open any free lesson in full.

The connection is read-only and needs no account. It receives catalog lookups (a topic, a grade, or a standards code) and never asks for students' names or work.
